about: The labelling guide's hard cases (section 4.2, guide 1.2) as test data for the cue table (specs/reader.md, rung 2): one entry per sentence and event kind, with the label the guide gives. Cases 25 (a corrected value) and 26 (a contradiction the guide sends back to the writer) carry no polarity to test. The cue table must give no wrong vote: the expected label, or no vote.
